title: 西嶺來客
logline: 西嶺兩位隱士同日下山：滄瀾客為救寂聞來盟，岳嵐客化名赤羽帶著「能救沈歸鶴」的藥而來；無名劍客攔下毒藥，卻沒攔住赤羽換掉寂聞的藥。

characters.name: 包三錢
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes, hair in a lopsided topknot with a cheap copper pin. Patched ochre and brown layered robe with mismatched embroidered trims, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string at his belt, a wide straw hat pushed back on his head. Always half-crouched, always listening.

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；四十多歲男聲，偏高、語速快、油滑，愛討價還價；害怕時聲音發緊、句子變短。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes, soaked to the skin and shivering, his lopsided topknot collapsed with the cheap copper pin hanging loose, wet hair plastered to his forehead and neck. Patched ochre and brown layered robe dark and dripping with seawater, a coarse grey wool blanket wrapped around his shoulders, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string at his belt, the wide straw hat hanging soaked down his back by its cord. Hunched over, clutching the blanket closed.

Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes now red-rimmed and watery, nose and cheeks flushed with fever, his lopsided topknot loosened and sagging with the cheap copper pin askew. A plain off-white padded inner robe under a thick patched indigo quilt wrapped around his shoulders like a cape, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string tied at his waist, no straw hat. Half-crouched and sniffling, still listening.

characters.name: 滄瀾客
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime mountain hermit in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall weathered man in his fifties, long steel-grey hair worn loose under a plain dark-blue cloth crown, deep-set eyes, a long thin scar across the bridge of the nose, skin burned dark by wind and snow. Layered robe of deep ocean blue and storm grey with embroidered rolling-wave hems, a heavy fur-lined travel mantle of dark grey fur over his shoulders, a plain long sword in a worn dark-blue scabbard at his left hip. Stands planted like a man on a ridge in the wind and says little.

voice.name: Zubenelgenubi
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；五十多歲男聲，低、乾、粗一點，像被嶺上的風磨過；語速慢，不客套、不繞彎，一句說完就停；對寂聞多一分耐心，像對年少時一起練功的師弟；說到折壽像在說天氣，說到寂聞的命時聲音才壓低。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime mountain hermit in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall weathered man in his fifties, long steel-grey hair worn loose and tangled under a plain dark-blue cloth crown knocked slightly askew, deep-set eyes heavy with exhaustion, a long thin scar across the bridge of the nose, skin burned dark by wind and snow, now drained grey and beaded with sweat. Layered robe of deep ocean blue and storm grey with embroidered rolling-wave hems, torn open across the chest and ripped ragged at both forearms, grey rock dust on his shoulders and hems, the heavy fur-lined travel mantle of dark grey fur torn and slipping off his left shoulder, a plain long sword in a worn dark-blue scabbard at his left hip. Still on his feet, but only just; every breath comes hard.

characters.name: 寂聞「怒目佛」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head under a tall gilded lotus crown with hanging gold bead strands, thick dark brows, fierce wide amber eyes. Layered saffron and crimson kasaya over a dark undershirt, a heavy embroidered collar with gold flame patterns, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; when he gathers force a golden aura rises around his right palm.

voice.name: Alnilam
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；四十多歲男聲，渾厚、硬、胸腔共鳴重；句子短，說出口就不收回；動怒時不吼，字字往下壓。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head under a tall gilded lotus crown with hanging gold bead strands, thick dark brows, fierce wide amber eyes, his face drained grey-pale with cold sweat at the temples. Layered saffron and crimson kasaya over a dark undershirt, a heavy embroidered collar with gold flame patterns, the kasaya and undershirt torn open over the left chest where a palm-sized blue-green star-shaped arrow scar glows faintly on the bare skin over his heart, no arrow and no blood, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; no golden aura around his palms.

Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head bare with no crown, thick dark brows, wide amber eyes gone dull and heavy-lidded, his face pale and drawn. A plain grey monk's robe loosely closed over a white undershirt, no kasaya and no embroidered collar, the loose neckline showing the edge of a blue-green star-shaped arrow scar on the skin over his heart, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; no golden aura. His broad shoulders slump; he cannot sit straight without support.

characters.name: 洛青衍
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime young envoy in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: slender youth of twenty, long dark blue-black hair half tied under a low sea-green coral crown, clear bright eyes, an open friendly face, a small crescent birthmark on the back of his neck usually hidden by his hair and collar. Sea-green and ivory layered island robe with wave-pattern embroidery and a white shell-clasp belt. Unarmed.

voice.name: Achird
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；二十歲男聲，明亮、乾淨、好奇，語速中等，帶一點海島來的客氣。

characters.name: 紗女
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime veiled woman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: slender figure of ambiguous age, waist-length pale silver-white hair worn loose under a low translucent white gauze veil-crown that hides the whole upper half of her face, only a calm pale mouth and chin visible below the veil. Layered robe of pale moonlight-white and grey gauze with faint silver crane embroidery, very long trailing sleeves that never seem to touch the ground, bare feet. Unarmed; carries nothing. Moves without a sound.

voice.name: Iapetus
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；三十多歲男聲——紗女是沈歸鶴的分魂，用的就是他的聲音，不配女聲；比沈歸鶴更輕、更慢、更柔，幾乎不用力氣，像隔著一層紗說話，句尾收得更輕；不咳。

characters.name: 沈歸鶴「白鶴先生」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime wuxia strategist in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall slender man in his thirties, very long straight ink-black hair falling past the waist, a tall white jade crown with a single white crane-feather pin, pale calm face, narrow grey eyes. Layered white silk robe embroidered with silver cranes and cloud scrolls, very wide sleeves, a pale blue sash, one folded white paper fan held in his right hand or tucked in the sash. No other weapon. Moves slowly and never raises his voice.

voice.name: Iapetus
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；三十多歲男聲，清朗、溫和、不疾不徐，從不提高音量；越要緊的話越輕、越慢，偶爾壓住一聲咳。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime wuxia strategist in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall slender man in his thirties, very long straight ink-black hair unbound and spread loose over the pillow and his shoulders, no crown and no crane-feather pin, pale face gone grey-white with dark hollows under the eyes, narrow grey eyes closed or half-open and unfocused, dry colourless lips. A plain undyed white silk inner robe loosely closed at the collar, no embroidered outer robe, no sash, no fan and no weapon. Lies on his back without moving; his breathing is shallow and his hands rest empty at his sides.

characters.name: 書院長老
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime academy elder in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: stout dignified old man in his sixties, round full face, heavy-lidded shrewd eyes, a neatly combed grey goatee and a long drooping grey moustache, grey hair gathered under a tall black lacquered scholar's crown edged with gold. Layered ivory-white and deep indigo scholar's robe embroidered with gold book-scroll and writing-brush patterns, very wide sleeves, a broad gold-embroidered belt, a plain ivory tablet held upright in both hands. Unarmed. Sits heavily and speaks without hurrying.

voice.name: Orus
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；六十多歲男聲，中低音、圓、穩，慢條斯理，像在講堂上說話；客氣裡帶著上位者的分量，不爭也不急；表態時一字一頓，說完就不再加一句。

characters.name: 無名劍客
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime nameless swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall lean figure, very long straight ink-black hair tied severely back under a plain white iron crown, the face hidden behind a featureless white half-mask that covers everything above the jaw, only a hard mouth and jaw visible. Layered robe of stark white and black with no embroidery at all, sleeves bound at the wrists, a black sash, one long straight sword with a plain white hilt in a plain black scabbard at his left hip. Stands like a drawn blade and says nothing he does not need to.

voice.name: Iapetus
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；三十多歲男聲——無名劍客是沈歸鶴的分魂，用的就是他的聲音；比沈歸鶴更硬、更短、更冷，字字出口就收，不解釋、不拖尾、沒有笑意；不咳。

characters.name: 玄門執事長老
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime Taoist steward in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: narrow-shouldered, slightly stooped man in his late fifties, thinning grey hair in a small topknot under a plain dark-teal cloth Taoist cap, long thin face, anxious narrow eyes, a wispy grey beard. Layered dark-teal and grey Taoist robe with plain silver cloud trim at the hems, a ring of brass keys and a thin cloth-bound ledger hanging at his sash. Unarmed, no whisk. Keeps his hands clasped tight inside his sleeves.

voice.name: Charon
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；五十多歲男聲，中音偏薄，語速稍快，像管帳的人在念數目；自己不會武功，在高手面前說話先賠三分小心；講到玄門的人和東西時聲音繃緊，激動時會停半拍再說下去。

characters.name: 燕迴「赤纓」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime wild sabre fighter in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall muscular man in his thirties, long dark-brown hair loose and windblown under a cracked bronze crown worn crooked, stubble, a loud grin. Layered rust-brown and black robe with torn embroidered hems, the left sleeve ripped off at the shoulder, one wide curved sabre with a red tassel carried over his right shoulder. Always first through the door.

voice.name: Fenrir
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；三十多歲男聲，粗、大嗓門、爽快，語尾上揚；認真起來一下子沉下去。

characters.name: 殷無聲「啞劍」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime mute swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: lean young man in his late twenties, long black hair tied high with a plain iron ring, pale face with a thin old scar across the left cheek, dark watchful eyes. Charcoal and slate layered robe with narrow white embroidered trim, sleeves bound tight at the wrists, one straight sword in a plain black scabbard worn across his back with the hilt above his right shoulder. Stands very still and speaks only with small hand signs.

voice.name: Sadaltager
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；二十多歲男聲，低、輕（角色天生不能說話，本集沒有台詞；聲音只為角色檔完整而設）。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime mute swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: lean young man in his late twenties, black hair tied high with a plain iron ring, the tail below the ring cut off bluntly so it now ends at his shoulders, pale face with a thin old scar across the left cheek, dark watchful eyes. Charcoal and slate layered robe with narrow white embroidered trim, sleeves bound tight at the wrists, one straight sword in a plain black scabbard worn across his back with the hilt above his right shoulder. Stands very still and speaks only with small hand signs.

characters.name: 岳嵐客「赤羽」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime disguised healer in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair gathered in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes, the nose and mouth hidden behind a plain russet gauze half-veil tied behind the ears so that only the eyes and brow show. A plain dark russet-red healer's robe of layered cloth with no embroidery, a bronze-brown sash, long trailing sleeves, a physician's black lacquered medicine box hanging on a strap over his right shoulder. Unarmed. Bows readily and never hurries.

voice.name: Algieba
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；看不出年紀的男聲，平穩、溫和、有磁性，永遠不急，像大夫在病榻前安撫人；每句都客氣，客氣裡帶一點壓人的分量；化名赤羽與現出真身是同一個聲音，被揭穿、被廢臂時不喊不叫，只是笑意更淡、字更慢。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime unmasked grandmaster in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes and a thin courteous smile, the russet gauze half-veil torn loose and hanging around his neck so that his whole face shows. His plain dark russet-red healer's robe slashed open from the left shoulder across the chest, the cut flaps turned back to show the inner lining embroidered with the twin-abyss crest of the Red Abyss Palace, two dark whirlpools side by side in bronze thread; a bronze-brown sash, long trailing sleeves, both arms whole, no medicine box. Unarmed. Keeps his feet and keeps smiling.

Original 2D anime unmasked grandmaster in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes and a thin courteous smile gone pale, the russet gauze half-veil torn loose and hanging around his neck so his whole face shows. His plain dark russet-red healer's robe slashed open from the left shoulder across the chest, the cut flaps turned back to show the inner lining embroidered with the twin-abyss crest of the Red Abyss Palace, two dark whirlpools side by side in bronze thread; his left arm hangs limp and useless, the left sleeve soaked dark with blood from shoulder to cuff; a bronze-brown sash, no medicine box. Unarmed. Keeps his feet and does not hurry.

Original 2D anime unmasked grandmaster in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall composed man of indeterminate age, long dark-red hair in a plain high knot held by a single bronze pin, no crown, calm half-lidded eyes and a thin courteous smile gone pale, the russet gauze half-veil torn loose and hanging around his neck so his whole face shows. His plain dark russet-red healer's robe slashed open from the left shoulder across the chest, the cut flaps pulled closed over his chest and held there by his right hand so the lining is hidden, only a thin glint of bronze thread showing between his fingers; his left arm hangs limp and useless, the left sleeve soaked dark with blood from shoulder to cuff; a bronze-brown sash, no medicine box. Unarmed. Keeps his feet and does not hurry.

beats.title: 西嶺來客
beats.logline: 西嶺兩位隱士同日下山：滄瀾客為救寂聞來盟，岳嵐客化名赤羽帶著「能救沈歸鶴」的藥而來；無名劍客攔下毒藥，卻沒攔住赤羽換掉寂聞的藥。
beats.hook: 西嶺雪線上兩道腳印分向兩邊：一個披毛皮斗篷的老者往東走向三宗盟，一個紅衣人往南走向海港，兩人在嶺口擦肩，都沒有回頭。
beats.conflict: 滄瀾客是寂聞的至交，他說封功可以解，但要在寒潭以至交的血引，引血者折壽；寂聞不肯讓他折壽。赤羽拿著一瓶據稱能壓沈歸鶴舊傷的火脊丹，紗女與包三錢要不要給昏病的本體服下——不服，本體撐不過入秋；服了，藥是誰的？
beats.turn: 無名劍客在客院截下赤羽的藥童，劍尖挑開丹藥，裡面是能化散元神的陰毒；他追赤羽到海港，赤羽脫下紅衣，衣內繡著赤淵宮的雙淵紋——他是赤淵宮大宮主岳嵐客，無名劍客一劍廢了他的左臂，卻被三宗守衛當成襲擊貴客而攔下。

cliffhanger.text: 梵林寺禪房外，赤羽的藥童把一只空瓶丟進井裡；禪房內，殷無聲端起寂聞每日的湯藥，藥面浮著一層不該有的紅。

general_payoffs: 無名劍客攔下赤羽毒害沈歸鶴本體的丹藥，並查出赤羽真身是赤淵宮大宮主岳嵐客；滄瀾客抵盟，說出封功可解的條件。
beats.theme: 來救你的人和來害你的人，走的是同一條山路

high_tension.event: 滄瀾客在禪房對寂聞說出寒潭引血之法，自己已帶來引血的刀；寂聞以封功之身一掌推開他，說「我不用你的壽來買我的功」，兩人在禪房內以言語相逼，殷無聲持劍橫在門口不讓任何人進。
high_tension.stakes: 滄瀾客引血，折壽不可逆；寂聞不解封，三宗在姬無霜面前就永遠少一個先天。
high_tension.consequence: 寂聞拒絕，滄瀾客留在梵林寺不走；三宗高層得知寂聞「可解封」，開始催促。

high_tension.event: 盟府外港，無名劍客追上要登船的赤羽，一劍劃開紅衣露出赤淵宮雙淵紋，再一劍廢其左臂；燕迴率守衛趕到，認得赤羽是三宗的貴客，反把無名劍客圍住，赤羽趁亂登船而去。
high_tension.stakes: 無名劍客殺赤羽，就是沈歸鶴的化身當眾殺三宗貴客；放他走，赤淵宮知道三宗內有人認出了他們。
high_tension.consequence: 岳嵐客左臂被廢逃回赤淵宮，三宗仍視赤羽為被襲的貴客；無名劍客被盟內記了一筆「無故傷客」，沈歸鶴本體因化身受創而咳血。

beats.consequence: 赤淵宮第一次被三宗內的人認出，但三宗不信；滄瀾客留在梵林寺等寂聞改口；赤羽留下的藥童換了寂聞的湯藥，殷無聲發現時藥已端在手上。紗女代昏病的本體拒了一切外來的藥，改以玄門的養氣法暫壓舊傷。

state.knowledge: 觀眾、無名劍客、紗女知道赤羽是赤淵宮大宮主岳嵐客且藥有毒；三宗高層視赤羽為貴客；寂聞與滄瀾客知道封功可解但需折壽；殷無聲懷疑湯藥被換。
state.character_state: 岳嵐客左臂被廢逃回赤淵宮；滄瀾客駐梵林寺；寂聞仍封功；沈歸鶴本體因無名劍客受創而加重；洛青衍在客院旁觀整場，對無名劍客生出敬意。
state.evidence: 挑開的毒丹、赤羽紅衣內的雙淵紋碎片、井裡的空瓶、浮紅的湯藥。
state.carry_forward: 寂聞的藥被換了什麼；滄瀾客的血引之法；赤淵宮為什麼要沈歸鶴死。

earlier.title: 幽皇之女
earlier.logline: 幽皇死後一年，他的女兒帶著幽都老弱跪在三宗盟門前求收容；沈歸鶴接下她，當夜玄門長老死在房中，無傷無血。

earlier.title: 鯨背嶼
earlier.logline: 鯨背嶼上的孩童一夜之間全部睡著不醒，包三錢潛入島底發現收魂陣；竹虛道人為沈歸鶴的舊傷西行，沈歸鶴咳血瞞住寂聞。

earlier.title: 三十六魂
earlier.logline: 柳不活在荒原找到自罰的鑄箭匠聶孤鐵，問出無歸箭要三股三宗精元才能發射；姬無霜在盟內請命剿鬼燈君，柳不活看見她手背的三宗印只差一道。

earlier.title: 裂山秘錄
earlier.logline: 盟內傳單指竹虛道人盜走玄門鎮派的《裂山秘錄》叛逃，三宗發九洲通緝，沈歸鶴被迫同意；竹虛在齊雲殿被圍，交出的秘錄翻開竟是無字。

earlier.title: 封功
earlier.logline: 三宗以為玄門長老死於第一支箭，所以把這一箭叫第二支；箭光劃過夜空，寂聞中箭，當場自封畢生功力保住元神；放箭的人穿著鬼燈君的黑袍，姬無霜借機接掌鯨背嶼防務，三宗全信她。

earlier.title: 紗女
earlier.logline: 沈歸鶴倒下，床前出現一名蒙紗女子與一名無名劍客替他行走江湖；扶瀾國使者洛青衍抵盟，姬無霜看見他頸後的胎記。

next_logline: 鯨背嶼海面浮起千盞燈，滄瀾客硬闖島底破陣，昏睡的孩童甦醒，鬼燈君現身；紗女揭露收魂陣是鬼燈君嫁禍姬無霜的局，姬無霜當場斬鬼燈君奪回幽都。

mysteries.question: 寂聞封功後怎麼回來？
mysteries.answer: 第 7 集赤羽的藥童在他的湯藥裡換進能讓封功者永不能解封的藥，殷無聲發現藥面浮紅，從那夜起每一碗都倒在井邊，寂聞一口沒喝；第 11 集滄瀾客在寒潭邊認出井邊藥渣是什麼，以自己的血引寒潭，寂聞沉潭重生，滄瀾客折壽。

series.title: 偶的江湖
series.premise: 三宗盟一年前聯手誅殺幽皇，卻把三十六條人命鑄成的無歸箭丟了；箭回來的那天，幽皇之女跪在三宗門前求收容。
